correctness.rationale: Exact binary-split recurrence is proved by induction on depth. The VC formula follows from distinct private prime valuations and primorial realizers, and comparing monotone intervals gives the first-gap claim.

value.rationale: The least initial interval whose divisibility concept family exhibits an adaptive/static rank gap of three is a naturally defined sharp transition between online mistake complexity and static VC complexity; the cutoff is not an arbitrary chosen numerical example. The exact first-seven rank thresholds and 128-path adversarial witness expose the arithmetic onset and make the cutoff useful for further studies of model-theoretic stability in arithmetic incidence systems.
